title: Na Raha Koyi Mera Chahane Wala Zainab
body:
Na Raha Koyi Mera Chahane Wala Zainab
Ja Raha Hai TujheAb Chodke Bhayya Zainab
Mere Akbar Ke Kaleje Me Lagi Thi Barchi
Qakh Me Milgaye Tasveer Mere Nana Ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Bholunga Mai Akbar Ka Tadapna Zainab
Run Me Pamal Huwa Dilbar-e-Shabbar Ka Badan
Meri Beti Huwi Bewa Jo Abhi Thi Dulhan
Tumko Dena Hai Usse Bhi Tho Dilasa Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankh Me Teer Laga Gurz-e-Sitam Sar Pa Laga
Hoke Bedasth Gira Ghode Se Bhai Mera
Mere Abbas Ne Mujko Kiya Tanha Zainab
Tere Bacchon Ka Bhi tho Daag Hai Mere Dil-Par
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Hi Din Me Jigar Par Chale Kitne Qanjar
Ab Sonaoun Tujhe Tafseel Mai Kya Kya Zainab
Rahem Khaya Na Kisi Ne Bhi Mere Asghar Par
Mere Haathoun Pa Huwa Zibha Mera Laqte Jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Maa Dekhegi Ujda Huwa Jhula Zainab
Sogaye Dashth Me Sab Chahane Wale Mere
Kaisi Gurbath Me Mera Saath Ye Sab Chod Gaye
Kisko Awaaz Du Ab Kaun Hai Mera Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunke Majaey Ki Batain Huwee Bechain Behan
Tha Rasheed Us Gadi Shabbir Ke Lap Pa Ye Suqan
Ab Khuda Hafizo Naser Tera Bhayya Zainab
